$description: Siterra design tokens 1.3: base scales plus the light (daylight, the default) and dark color themes. Format: DTCG 2025.10 (ADR-0029). Colors are srgb with hex; OKLCH components are under $extensions.siterra.oklch. The light theme carries the founder-approved hero's daylight colours (palette.light.daylight) and the data the hero draws; dark is kept and is not the default. Rationale: docs/reference/design-system.md and research/design/color-system.md.

ring.$description: 2 px with a 2 px offset, 4 px on the key slot (border.focus-ring, border.focus-offset); ink, as the approved hero draws it; at least 3:1 on every persistent background

map-inner.$description: Two-tone focus over the map: inner ring (WCAG technique C40, >= 9:1 between the tones)

ndvi.$description: Raw NDVI, 7 classes low to high, fixed domain stated in the legend. cmocean speed (MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 Kristen M. Thyng), exact rows at the class centres.

ndvi-departure.$description: NDVI departure from the same-month reference: warm arm = less green than reference, green arm = greener. Custom, symmetric arms, neutral centre.

scale.rule: Fixed scale, never rescaled per period. Within 0.005 of zero the land is left unpainted. Beyond it, t = (|d| - 0.005) / 0.095 clamped to 0..1 picks the colour along steps 1 to 3 of its arm and an opacity of 0.10 + 0.70 t.

unpainted.$description: The neutral band in the key, left unpainted as on the land

rain-departure.$description: Departure from the 1991 to 2020 mean (mm): the shared warm arm for drier, a violet arm for wetter. Not drawn in a view that shows data.rain-total.

categorical.$description: Strata or series identity: three hued slots in fixed order plus a neutral 'other' that is always dashed or patterned; never value colors

other.$description: Fourth category: neutral, always with a dash or pattern (not separable from slot 3 by color alone under CVD simulation)

no-observation-hatch.$description: No valid observation: 45 degree hatch, 1 px stroke, 6 px spacing, over the map ground; never a value color

excluded-hatch.$description: Deliberately excluded stratum: 135 degree hatch, 1 px stroke, 6 px spacing; legend states the reason

opacity.$description: Raster opacity over relief; computed minimum for class order to survive hillshade modulation is 0.83 (light NDVI)

rain-total.$description: Season rainfall totals per CHIRPS cell, painted flat at true cell size in three display classes (a sequential ramp; the key says "display classes").

siterra.opacity: about 0.10 outside the catchment rising to 0.34 inside it

key-opacity.$description: The classes' swatches in the key

band.$description: The three elevation bands (sampling strata, not pasture units): the shadow tint at three clearly separate strengths, no border weight.

limit.$description: The band limits as thin contour lines, 1.5 px

season.$description: The season stems: one 3D object beside the catchment, the reference seasons around the 1991 to 2020 mean.

stem-recent.$description: The season before the one on show, 2 px

stem-on-show.$description: The season on show, 3 px; its label in the accent

no-observation-hatch-edge.$description: The gap swatch's edge beside its reason

excluded-hatch-edge.$description: The excluded swatch's edge beside its reason

water-line.$description: Streams and rivers; APCA Lc 30 on map.land

label.$description: Names on the land in IBM Plex Sans Medium on a thin paper halo, never a dark outline

fog.$description: Haze: radial from the catchment centre (24 to 52 km to paper) and with distance from the eye (70 to 190 km, 55 per cent)

outline.$description: The catchment line: 1.5 px on the ridge crest plus 30 m

front.$description: A measurement front crossing the catchment: about 1.5 px at any distance
